channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula e Trump: veja o que foi falado e o que ficou de fora da reunião
item.description: Lula and Trump met at the White House to strengthen Brazil-U.S. relations, focusing on economic partnership, trade, and multilateralism. Lula emphasized that the designation of Brazilian factions as terrorist groups and U.S. attacks on payment systems like PIX were not discussed.

item.title: O tempo próprio de Minas
item.description: Minas Gerais plays a central role in national politics as Brazil’s second-largest electoral college, with a socially and regionally diverse electorate that historically mirrors the national average vote. This makes the state a reliable bellwether for national electoral trends. The article highlights this uniqueness but is accessible only to subscribers.

item.title: Leia a íntegra da entrevista de Lula pós-reunião com Trump
item.description: Lula said the meeting with Trump was an important step in strengthening the democratic relationship between Brazil and the United States, emphasizing that the two largest democracies in the hemisphere can serve as a global example. He noted that the U.S. was Brazil’s top trading partner throughout the 20th century but lost ground to China after 2008, urging the U.S. to re-engage with Brazilian exports, especially in infrastructure tenders where Chinese firms now dominate. Lula also highlighted Brazil’s efforts to diversify partnerships through agreements with the EU, Mercosul, EFTA, and Singapore, as global attention returns to Latin America amid current geopolitical tensions.

item.title: Reunião com Trump na Casa Branca foi boa para Lula? Analistas respondem
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva described his three-hour meeting with Donald Trump at the White House as 'very productive,' but analysts question whether the encounter yielded concrete benefits for Brazil. While the tone was cordial, experts note no significant agreements were reached on trade, climate, or immigration, raising doubts about the meeting's political and diplomatic impact for Lula.

item.title: Lula deve amenizar críticas a Trump durante período de negociações após encontro
item.description: President Lula will soften his criticism of Trump during a 30-day period set for tariff negotiations, avoiding offensive remarks after their White House meeting. He proposed the timeline to discuss trade taxes, noting that the average U.S. product tariff in Brazil is 2.7%, though the U.S. claims some reach 12%. Brazil also aims to prevent the U.S. from labeling Brazilian criminal factions as terrorists and halting investigations under Section 301 of the 1974 Trade Act.

item.title: Sem citar Ciro, Flávio diz que operação da PF foi correta
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro defended the fifth phase of the Federal Police's Operation Compliance Zero, which targeted Senator Ciro Nogueira without naming him directly. He stated that the allegations in the Master case are serious and that Justice André Mendonça acted correctly in authorizing the operation, emphasizing the need for investigation without political shielding. Flávio also supported establishing a parliamentary inquiry commission to investigate alleged irregularities at Banco Master involving Ciro Nogueira and Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Não dá pra defender outra bandeira, diz Alckmin em vídeo do PSB
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) appeared in a party video defending Brazilian sovereignty, stating that 'it is not possible to defend another flag'. The speech contrasts with 2018 episodes where Bolsonaro supporters were photographed with U.S. flags and then-President Donald Trump backed Bolsonaro, sanctioning Brazilian officials and urging the STF to halt his trial.

item.title: “Um bom homem, um cara inteligente”, diz Trump sobre Lula
item.description: Donald Trump praised Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, calling him 'a good man, a smart guy', and said their conversation focused on trade tariffs, with Brazil requesting relief from U.S.-imposed duties. He described the meeting as positive and emphasized the importance of the bilateral trade relationship.

item.title: Zema critica silêncio de Lula sobre operação da PF que mirou Ciro Nogueira e Banco Master
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pre-candidate for president under Novo, criticized President Lula's silence regarding the fifth phase of Operation Compliance Zero, which targeted Senator Ciro Nogueira and Banco Master. Zema highlighted the federal government's lack of transparency regarding a Federal Police operation with significant political targets.

item.title: Trump volta a falar de reunião com Lula e elogia petista
item.description: Donald Trump praised Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva following their meeting on Thursday, calling him 'a good man' and 'a smart guy'. He described the meeting as 'very productive' and emphasized plans to boost bilateral trade, including potential tariff relief. Trump also said further meetings would be scheduled in the coming months to address key issues.

item.title: Trump diz que reunião com Lula foi 'ótima' e que o brasileiro é 'um homem bom, um cara inteligente'
item.description: Donald Trump praised Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva following a three-hour meeting at the White House, calling him 'a good man, a smart guy' and emphasizing the productivity of the discussion, which centered on trade and tariffs. Lula reciprocated the praise, describing the meeting as 'positive' and highlighting the strengthening relationship between the two nations, including joking with Trump about not revoking visas for Brazilian football players ahead of the 2026 World Cup hosted by the U.S., Mexico, and Canada.

item.title: França sugere Tebet ou Marina como vice para resolver impasse na chapa de Haddad
item.description: Former minister Márcio França proposed that Simone Tebet (PSB) or Marina Silva (Rede) be chosen as Fernando Haddad’s (PT) running mate for São Paulo governor to resolve the alliance impasse. He suggested balancing the ticket with a governor and female vice-governor, plus a senator and female senator, contrasting it with Tarcísio de Freitas’s all-male ticket. Tebet has rejected the vice role, while Marina has not yet publicly commented.

item.title: Lula en Washington: Trump dice que no invadirá Cuba
item.description: During a meeting at the White House, U.S. President Donald Trump reassured Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva that he does not plan to invade Cuba, despite his frequent aggressive rhetoric on the matter. Lula described the statement as a sign of de-escalation in regional tensions. The meeting took place on Thursday and also covered other items on the bilateral agenda.

item.title: Drible na imprensa, 'clara sintonia' : o que os jornais do mundo disseram sobre encontro de Lula e Trump
item.description: The meeting between Lula and Trump in Washington received wide international coverage, emphasizing the 'clear rapport' between the two leaders despite ideological differences. Outlets such as El País and Le Monde highlighted the symbolic reception gestures, the extended duration of the talks, and the electoral boost for Lula ahead of Brazil's 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Líder da Libertadores, Corinthians garante vaga antecipada nas oitavas
item.description: Corinthians secured an early spot in the 2026 Libertadores round of 16 after Platense and Peñarol drew, giving the Brazilian side 10 points and an unassailable lead in Group E. The team leads the tournament and will have home advantage in knockout matches until a potential semifinal, despite struggling to avoid relegation in the Brazilian league. Their next match is against Peñarol in Montevideo on May 21.

item.title: Relator de minerais críticos diz que Brasil quer investimento “de onde vier”
item.description: The rapporteur of the critical minerals bill, federal deputy Arnaldo Jardim (Cidadania-SP), stated that Brazil seeks to attract investments in critical minerals 'from wherever they come,' following the meeting between Lula and Trump. The bill, approved by the Chamber of Deputies, establishes the National Critical Minerals Policy, provides for a guarantor fund of up to R$5 billion and incentives from 2030 to 2034, with no partner exclusivity. Lula noted Brazil has explored only 30% of its territory and aims to open the sector to investments from the U.S., China, and Europe.

item.title: Janaina sugere Tereza Cristina no comando do PP no lugar de Ciro
item.description: São Paulo councilwoman Janaina Paschoal suggested that Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) should assume the national presidency of the Progressistas (PP) party, replacing Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI), who is under investigation in the fifth phase of Operation Compliance Zero, launched by the Federal Police under STF order. Paschoal stated that Nogueira should step down from party leadership amid the ongoing probe.

item.title: Lula propõe a Trump grupo de trabalho para resolver tarifaço em 30 dias
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva proposed to U.S. President Donald Trump the creation of a bilateral working group to resolve, within 30 days, trade disputes involving tariffs between Brazil and the United States. Lula said the group would bring together technical teams from both countries to develop a concrete solution to the so-called 'tariff barrage', with a final proposal to be presented to the presidents after the deadline. The initiative will also cover rare earths, foreign investment, and industrial cooperation.

item.title: Lula conversa com Trump sobre tarifas, combate ao crime organizado e minerais críticos
item.description: President Lula spoke with Donald Trump about tariffs, organized crime, and critical minerals, emphasizing that combating drug trafficking requires economic alternatives, not just military action. He criticized the U.S. strategy of installing foreign military bases without addressing the root causes.

item.title: Brasil e EUA avançam para acordo contra lavagem de dinheiro, diz Durigan
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan stated that Brazil and the United States are close to reaching new agreements on customs and money laundering prevention. The comment followed a meeting between President Lula and President Donald Trump at the White House.

item.title: Transparência, inclusão e decisões estruturantes marcaram a preparação para as Eleições 2026
item.description: Under Minister Cármen Lúcia's leadership, the TSE advanced transparency, inclusion, and normative refinement for the 2026 elections, notably through the release of electronic voting machine source code and record participation in the 2025 Public Urn Test. These actions strengthened electoral security, auditability, and integrity, institutionalizing lasting reforms before her term ends on March 12.

item.title: STF arquiva ação de Bolsonaro contra Lula e Gleisi por crimes contra honra
item.description: The STF dismissed a lawsuit filed by Jair Bolsonaro against President Lula and federal deputy Gleisi Hoffmann over alleged honor crimes during the 2022 election campaign. The court ruled that the alleged statements did not constitute criminal defamation under Brazilian law. The decision reflects the STF's tendency to protect political speech within electoral discourse from criminal prosecution.

item.title: Alcolumbre e Lula querem fazer as pazes?
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP) signaled willingness to resume dialogue with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva following tensions over the rejection of Jorge Messias’ nomination to the Supreme Federal Court. According to Folha de S.Paulo, Alcolumbre sent a message to the Planalto stating that if Lula wants to make peace, he does too. The initiative aims to smooth over the institutional rift and restore cooperation between the branches of government.

item.title: Lula entrega a Trump cópia do acordo nuclear firmado com o Irã em 2010
item.description: President Lula delivered a copy of the 2010 nuclear agreement between Brazil, Turkey, and Iran — known as the Tehran Declaration — to Donald Trump during their White House meeting. He emphasized that the deal, built on patience and diplomatic persuasion, aimed to prevent Iran from developing nuclear weapons but was ultimately rejected by Western powers despite initial U.S. support under Obama.

item.title: Moraes autoriza regime aberto para hacker Walter Delgatti
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized Walter Delgatti Neto’s transition to open regime after serving part of an 8-year-and-3-month sentence for hacking the CNJ’s electronic systems, including inserting a false arrest warrant against Moraes himself. The ruling, based on a favorable PGR opinion and prison behavior reports, imposes electronic monitoring, mandatory nighttime and weekend home confinement, and a ban on leaving his residence comarca without prior judicial approval.

item.title: Mesmo sem definições, Lula elogia reunião com Trump e se diz ‘otimista’ sobre ‘parceria’ com os EUA
item.description: Lula said his meeting with Trump was very productive and positive, emphasizing Brazil’s openness to international partnerships without geopolitical veto, including with the U.S., China, and others. He expressed optimism about advancing relations and stressed that Brazil aims to be a leader in critical mineral refining, not just an exporter. Although topics like Pix and terrorism designation were avoided, Lula noted that previously taboo subjects were addressed.

item.title: Nunes Marques arquiva ação de Bolsonaro contra Lula e Gleisi por ter sido chamado de ‘genocida’
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Kassio Nunes Marques dismissed a lawsuit filed by former President Jair Bolsonaro against President Lula and Deputy Gleisi Hoffmann for calling him a 'genocida'. The ruling stated the remarks were made in the context of political-electoral debate and do not constitute a crime, as there was no attribution of criminal responsibility. Lula and Gleisi were protected by temporary presidential immunity and parliamentary immunity, respectively.

item.title: Lula diz que Trump não tocou no assunto do Pix durante reunião
item.description: President Lula stated that Trump did not bring up the topic of Pix during their 3-hour meeting at the White House, despite Lula bringing the Finance Minister expecting to discuss it. Lula joked that he hopes Trump will one day use Pix, as many American companies already do. He proposed that officials from both countries meet within 30 days to resolve the trade dispute triggered by the U.S. investigation into Pix as an allegedly unfair trade practice.

item.title: Depois de reunião com Trump, Lula diz que não tem “vocação belicista”
item.description: Lula stated he has no 'warlike vocation' and believes more in dialogue than war, following a meeting with Trump at the White House. He criticized conflicts in Iran, Gaza, Lebanon, and Ukraine, proposed UN Security Council reform, and advocated for strengthening defense industry in the Global South, despite his pacifist stance.

item.title: Lula comenta operação da PF contra Ciro Nogueira
item.description: President Lula commented on the fifth phase of Operation Compliance Zero by the Federal Police, which targeted Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI), stating he hopes 'all investigated individuals are innocent'. He noted the difficulty of commenting on ongoing investigations, emphasizing the presumption of innocence. The report was originally published on O Antagonista.

item.title: PF chega ao centrão e coloca o Master perto de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Police advanced in Operation Compliace Zero, targeting Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI) for allegedly receiving trips and a monthly stipend of R$ 300 thousand from former banker Daniel Vorcaro, linked to the Master bank scandal. This proximity complicates Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) pre-campaign, hindering a potential alliance with PP-União Brasil and being exploited by the PT to boost his rejection, while simultaneously benefiting Lula by shifting focus from government-STF ties. The situation fuels tension within Bolsonaro’s base and leaves the centrist electorate as decisive in a highly polarized landscape.

item.title: Mesmo sem acordo com Trump, Lula volta dos EUA “muito otimista”
item.description: Lula met with Trump at the White House on May 7, 2026, without formal agreements but expressed optimism after establishing working groups to address the Section 301 trade investigation, combat organized crime, and advance critical minerals talks. The Brazilian government views the meeting as a political gain, opening negotiation channels and displaying a cordial relationship with the U.S. amid the Iran War, with a 30-day deadline for concrete proposals.

item.title: Lula sobre comércio entre Brasil e EUA: “Tem uma divergência entre eles e nós que ficou explicitada na reunião”
item.description: Presidents Lula and Donald Trump held a three-hour closed-door meeting in the Oval Office and agreed to resume negotiations on Brazilian import tariffs within 30 days, with their teams to meet again soon. However, Lula emphasized that a clear divergence remains between Brazil and the United States on trade policy.

item.title: PT quer usar caso Master para minar candidatura de Flávio
item.description: PT leaders aim to leverage investigations into Banco Master and PP president Ciro Nogueira to build a narrative linking the Centrão to alleged irregularities, thereby weakening Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) 2026 candidacy. The strategy seeks to associate the Rio de Janeiro senator with corruption schemes involving bank funds and allies of the previous government.

item.title: Alcolumbre pede agenda com Lula para restabelecer relação após derrota de Messias
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre reached out to the government to request a personal meeting with President Lula, aiming to mend relations after the Senate rejected the nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Court. The move seeks to overcome the political tension caused by the government's historic defeat last week, when the Senate blocked the administration's nominee for the vacant STF seat.

item.title: Encontro entre Lula e Trump repercute na mídia internacional
item.description: The meeting between Lula and Trump at the White House on May 7, 2026, lasted three hours and followed a period of diplomatic strain over trade disputes and the Bolsonaro legal proceedings. The cancellation of a joint press conference and absence of official statements drew international media attention, with outlets describing the atmosphere as a 'fragile truce' and a 'waiting game'. Nevertheless, both sides emphasized positive outcomes, with Trump calling Lula 'very dynamic' and Brazil highlighting the over-200-year friendship with the United States.

item.title: Segunda edição do Fórum VEJA Brazil Insights reúne autoridades em Nova York
item.description: The second VEJA Brazil Insights Forum in New York brings together authorities, business leaders, and political figures to discuss the impact of global economic changes on Brazil and prospects for the 2026 presidential elections. The event features debates on economy, governability, infrastructure, and polling, with participants including André Esteves, Michel Temer, Romeu Zema, and Murilo Hidalgo. Held at The Plaza Hotel, the forum aims to analyze Brazil’s challenges and opportunities in the international arena amid a shifting global geopolitical context.

item.title: Lula defende aproximação com EUA após encontro com Trump
item.description: President Lula advocated for closer ties with the United States following his meeting with Trump, emphasizing multilateralism and criticizing U.S. trade tariffs. He called for international cooperation against organized crime, drug and arms trafficking, and proposed a multinational working group involving Latin American nations. Lula also noted that the U.S. was Brazil’s top trading partner until 2008, when China surpassed it, and urged renewed American interest in Brazilian infrastructure investments.

item.title: Evento com Ciro Nogueira que oficializaria apoio do PP a Tarcísio em SP deve ser adiado
item.description: The event to formally announce the Progressistas' support for Tarcísio de Freitas' re-election in São Paulo was postponed due to Federal Police searches targeting Ciro Nogueira in Operation Compliance Zero, which investigates alleged monthly payments of R$300,000 from Banco Master's owner. Despite the postponement, the PP maintains its support for Tarcísio's ticket, with the governor planning to use the swearing-in of Minister Kassio Nunes Marques at the TSE as justification for the cancellation.

item.title: Lula descarta acesso preferencial dos EUA a terras-raras
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva rejected preferential access for the U.S. to Brazil’s rare earth minerals, stating that American, Chinese, German, Japanese, and French companies are all welcome as long as Brazil retains regulatory control. He emphasized recent memorandums with Spain, Germany, and India aimed at advancing industrialization and technology transfer while preserving national sovereignty over mineral resources.

item.title: “Genocida”: Kassio acolhe parecer da PGR e arquiva ação de Bolsonaro contra Lula
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques of the STF dismissed a lawsuit filed by Jair Bolsonaro against Lula and Gleisi Hoffmann for alleged slander during the 2022 election campaign, accepting the PGR’s opinion that the statements were political criticism within the electoral context and did not constitute criminal offenses. The ruling also noted the absence of a formal criminal complaint by Bolsonaro.

item.title: Sem citar Ciro Nogueira, Flávio diz que “informações são graves”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro issued a statement describing as grave the media reports on the Banco Master scandal, without naming Senator Ciro Nogueira, who is under investigation in the fifth phase of Operation Compliance Zero. The note expresses confidence in Minister André Mendonça's rapporteurship and calls for a rigorous and transparent investigation by the authorities.

item.title: Trump não fez declaração com Lula para falar com chefe da Comissão Europeia
item.description: President Donald Trump met with Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in Washington, D.C., on May 7, 2026, without a joint press statement due to the meeting running over time. Following the meeting, Trump called Ursula von der Leyen, President of the European Commission, to discuss trade tariffs and the Iran war. Lula spoke separately with journalists at the Brazilian Embassy, while Trump posted on Truth Social that the meeting went 'very well' and that additional meetings could be scheduled as needed.

item.title: Objetivo de Lula em Washington foi cumprido: apaziguar e protelar
item.description: President Lula achieved his goal in Washington of calming and delaying tensions with the U.S., avoiding the humiliating treatment other leaders faced from Trump. Although no concrete agreements were reached on tariffs, rare earths, or Security Council reform, Lula succeeded in keeping dialogue open and projecting a positive image, which is politically important in an election year.

item.title: Governistas usam avanço do caso Master sobre Centrão como estratégia eleitoral para enfraquecer Flávio
item.description: Lula’s allies plan to exploit the link between Centrão figures and banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master to weaken Flávio Bolsonaro’s 2026 campaign, using the term 'Bolso Master' to tie the scandal to the Bolsonaro clan. The strategy aims to block a potential alliance between the União Brasil-PP federation and Flávio, especially after the PF operation targeting Ciro Nogueira, former Bolsonaro minister and possible running mate. Government officials believe this approach could yield electoral gains for Lula while hindering cooperation between the Centrão and the opposition.

item.title: Lula diz ter entregue a Trump lista de autoridades que tiveram vistos revogados
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) stated on Thursday (7) that he delivered to U.S. President Donald Trump a list of Brazilian authorities whose visas were revoked under sanctions imposed over the past year. The list includes ministers of the Federal Supreme Court (STF), Attorney General Paulo Gonet, and their relatives. The remark was made during a press briefing and has sparked diplomatic repercussions.

item.title: Terras raras, crime organizado e elogios: como foi o encontro de Lula e Trump
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said he was 'very satisfied' with his meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday, the 7th. Topics discussed included combating organized crime and mineral exploration, including rare earths. Trump praised Lula on his Truth Social platform, calling him 'dynamic' and saying the meeting was 'very good'.

item.title: Nunes Marques arquiva pedido de Bolsonaro contra Lula e Gleisi por supostos crimes contra a honra
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Kassio Nunes Marques dismissed on Thursday a lawsuit filed by former president Jair Bolsonaro against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and federal deputy Gleisi Hoffmann for alleged crimes against honor during the 2022 election campaign. The ruling followed an assessment that insufficient evidence existed to proceed with the case. The article is available only to subscribers.

item.title: Sem acordos, Lula e Trump dão 30 dias para equipes negociarem tarifas
item.description: Lula and Trump agreed to establish working groups and give 30 days for technical teams to resolve commercial and tariff pending issues, without concrete agreements. The Brazilian president delivered written proposals in English, including demands for U.S. investment in critical minerals with local processing and clarified that any foreign platform may operate under Brazilian sovereign regulation, emphasizing the meeting's importance to prevent U.S. interference in the October elections.

item.title: Ricupero: Respeito de Trump a Lula fez reunião normal soar extraordinária
item.description: The meeting between Donald Trump and Lula at the White House was notable for Trump’s respectful tone, a stark contrast to his harsh treatment of leaders like Zelensky and Ramaphosa. According to former Brazilian ambassador Rubens Ricupero, despite the friendly reception and proposal to form a working group on tariffs, no concrete outcomes were achieved, particularly regarding ongoing U.S. surtaxes on Brazilian goods. The encounter was seen as 'extraordinary' only due to the shift in demeanor, not substantive progress.
